projectSummary: Establishes that internal-rotation leverage at the glenohumeral joint is dominated by the subscapularis rather than by the pectoralis major, which qualifies any statement that the pectoralis major is an internal rotator.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

study.intervention: Cadaveric tendon-excursion measurement of axial-rotation moment arms.
study.population: Instantaneous moment arms of 18 major muscle sub-regions crossing the glenohumeral joint were measured in axial rotation of the humerus during coronal-plane abduction and sagittal-plane flexion, by the tendon-excursion method in eight entire upper-extremity cadaver specimens.

title: Moment arms of the shoulder muscles during axial rotation.
